hints.title: Sliding Time Window Pruning
hints.text: Record incoming timestamps in chronological order and discard any earlier timestamps that fall strictly before t - 3000.

hints.title: Monotonic Front Eviction
hints.text: Push current timestamp t to the back. Evict timestamps from the front as long as they are strictly less than t - 3000.

hints.title: RecentCounter Ping Blueprint
hints.text: In ping(t): append t to requests. While requests[0] < t - 3000: pop front. Return len(requests).

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: W: maximum calls within 3000ms window (at most 3001)
complexity.notes: Each timestamp enters and leaves the container at most once yielding amortized constant time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Retaining all historical timestamps and scanning from beginning takes quadratic total time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Container size is bounded by window range 3000 rather than total call count.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of deque or two pointers to achieve amortized O(1) time complexity.
